senses.gloss: m. (עֲלֵי; cmp. יָעַל, תּוֹעֶלֶת) achievement, profit; good.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 13:2">Targ. II Chr. XIII, 2</cite> <he>שמא דמ׳</he> a name of good portent.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 4:9">Targ. Lam. IV, 9</cite> <he>מ׳</he> better off.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:28">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>בנין דלא מעלו</he> (cmp. <cite ref="B00875"><he>בְּלִיַּעַל</he></cite>) bad children; <he>בני דמ׳</he> (cmp. <cite ref="E00678"><he>הֲנָיָיה</he></cite> ch.) good children (Ms. M. <he>זרעא דמעלי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—Used as adj.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74b:8">B. Bath. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>מלחה מ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>עדיף</he>), v. <cite ref="M01523"><he>מֶלַח</he></cite> ch.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>לא מ׳</he> is of no good.
<cite ref="Ketubot 105b:6">Keth. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דמ׳ טפי</he> because they are better.
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:20">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>דמ׳ ביה שימשא</he> Ms. M. when lying in the sun is healthy.
<cite ref="Ketubot 62b:15">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>צניע ומ׳</he> pious and capable; a. fr.
